svg.title: Operational technology cyber security illustration
svg.desc: A side-view scene. On the left, an IT network with a cloud and server rack. A threat is blocked by a firewall wall with a shield, while a single approved conduit passes through a gate. On the right, a protected OT zone contains a control cabinet, a conveyor with a robot arm for manufacturing, a process tank and a transformer for energy and utilities, all linked by a secured control bus.
